parole.significato: an attaché; a diplomatic envoy holding the lowest official rank at a diplomatic mission
parole.testo: Unadapted borrowing from French attaché (“attaché”), literally “attached”, the substantivized past participle of attacher (“to attach, connect”), from Old French atachier (“to attach”), of Frankish origin; compare Frankish *stekan (“to stick, pierce, sting”), *stikkan and *stikjan, from Proto-German
